title: Vision House — Brand Identity
role: Creative Direction, Brand Identity, Visual System
summary: Building a brand identity for a marketing agency and TVC production house — from strategic positioning through to a complete visual system.

blocks.body: Vision House is a marketing agency and TVC production house operating across Iraq and the region. The brand needed an identity that carries the weight of a production company — cinematic, bold, premium — while staying flexible enough for the strategic side of the business. The result is a visual system that works equally on a film slate, a pitch deck, and a social feed.

REPLACE — What was the business challenge? What did Vision House need to communicate? Who are they competing against? What perception did they want to own in the market? One paragraph that proves you understood the problem before you designed anything.

REPLACE — The idea behind the mark. What does the symbol represent? What letters, shapes, or metaphors are embedded in it? How does it connect to the name 'Vision House' and the dual nature of the business (agency + production)?

blocks.caption: Clear space and minimum size rules

blocks.body: REPLACE — Why these colours? What do they signal in the production/agency world? How do the primary and secondary palettes work across screen and print?
REPLACE — The typeface pairing and why it was chosen. How the display face carries the brand's personality, how the body face supports readability across proposals, decks, and digital.
REPLACE — The supporting graphic system: patterns derived from the logo, texture choices, photographic direction, any signature graphic devices that make the brand recognisable even without the logo.

REPLACE — How the brand shows up in production contexts: slate/clapboard design, end-card, crew apparel, equipment labels, showreel intro. This is the section that separates Vision House from a generic agency identity — these are the touchpoints only a production house needs.
REPLACE — The system alive in real application. How it looks when everything comes together: a pitch meeting, a production set, a social feed, a client handover.
